original coordinate: i ~ TruncatedNormal(i0, e_i, 1, 90), sampled through NumPyro's interval transform
z_U ~ N(0,1) on R; likelihood = 0 where any included g_bar <= 0
revised coordinate: z_U = z_floor,i + exp(w_i) for galaxies with a positivity wall, z_U = w_i otherwise
prior on i: N(0,1) density retained on the support where the likelihood is non-zero (posterior identical)

revised coordinate: non-centred (unchanged; centred option has identical prior)
s ~ N(0,1), scale = 0.1|s| (exact folded normal) if REPARAM['scales'] == 'folded'
Jacobian: constant log(0.1/2) per scale (two-to-one map); likelihood depends on scale^2 only
